entities.summary: Józef Zabiełło h. Topór was a Polish–Lithuanian nobleman (szlachcic). Lithuanian Grand Master of the Hunt from 1775, konsyliarz of Permanent Council from 1782, deputy of Samogitia to the Great Sejm and Field Hetman of Lithuania from 1793, he was a supporter of the Russian Empire in the last years of the Commonwealth.

entities.summary: Józef Zabiełło h. Topór was a Polish–Lithuanian nobleman (szlachcic). Lithuanian Grand Master of the Hunt from 1775, konsyliarz of Permanent Council from 1782, deputy of Samogitia to the Great Sejm and Field Hetman of Lithuania from 1793, he was a supporter of the Russian Empire in the last years of the Commonwealth.
